triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Morning Post (7 AM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: Education/authority slot. Uses morning product from daily rotation. Generates Higgsfield women image for Revitalize, men image for Reclaim. Posts via Composio to both Instagram accounts using explicit account aliases (instagram_cardin-bulgar, instagram_medlar-slap). Verifies each post is live via INSTAGRAM_GET_IG_MEDIA before logging. No explicit Facebook call — Revitalize IG auto-syncs to Facebook.

triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Afternoon Post (3 PM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: Pain-point slot. 3 PM crash content. Uses afternoon product from daily rotation. Same verified posting pattern as morning trigger.

triggers.name: RTN + Reclaim — Evening Post (7 PM ET)
triggers.prompt_summary: Conversion/transformation slot. Same verified posting pattern as morning/afternoon, plus best-effort YouTube video upload for Reclaim (does not block Instagram logging on failure).
